editorial.headline: Engineering Advice, Design and the Bali PMA Reality
editorial.standfirst: A broad engineering and technical-consulting activity, open nationally to foreign investment and not blocked for PMA registration in Bali.
editorial.body:
This activity covers the engineering consultancy and design work that applies the laws of physics and engineering principles to machines, materials, instruments, structures, processes and systems. Its remit is deliberately wide: machinery and industrial processes sit alongside civil, hydraulic and traffic-engineering projects, as do residential and non-residential building engineering, water-resources civil works, mechanical building systems and sports-facility engineering. The common thread is technical judgement translated into engineered designs, systems and project solutions.

The scope also extends beyond design alone. It includes engineering advice and consultation, environmental technical consultancy, construction work connected with traffic-control systems, and engineering for power-generation networks, transmission, substations and electricity distribution. Industrial processes, production and production facilities are part of the picture, together with projects involving electrical and electronic, mining, chemical, mechanical, industrial, systems and safety engineering. Construction-related project management and field investigation belong here too, as do work involving air conditioning, refrigeration, sanitation, pollution control and acoustics. Geophysical, geological, geochemical and seismic surveys are included, along with geological and geophysical interpretation for the construction sector.

A business undertaking this kind of technical practice can register at every listed business scale: Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar. At the national level, foreign investment is permitted, and ownership by foreign investors can reach 100%. That is the central national position: a firm providing the engineering, consultancy, survey, project-management or related technical work described in the scope has a category built for a wide range of engineered projects rather than a narrow specialist assignment.

Bali requires a separate reading, but the result remains clear. The province permanently blocks PMA registration for all Low and Medium-Low risk activities across the island. This activity is not marked as blocked. Its Bali status is OK_or_HIGHER_RISK, and at the Besar scale its OSS risk is Medium-High/High; the record specifically states that it is not blocked by the moratorium. On the record supplied, the activity is therefore open nationally and remains available for PMA registration in Bali.
editorial.pullQuote: The national position is open, and Bali does not block this activity under its permanent PMA moratorium.
